story.metaDescription: Luca makes dental loupes: precise optics, healthy ergonomics and a custom build for every clinician.
story.title: The Luca story
story.subtitle: A tool that disappears, so you can see better.
story.intro: Luca makes dental loupes: a tool that has to sit on the face for hours and be forgotten. Every design decision starts there — more clarity, less weight and a healthier posture for the clinician.

optics.title: Glass, before anything else
optics.body: The quality of a loupe starts with its lens. Grinding, coating and alignment of each lens pair are checked before they are mounted on the frame.

ergonomics.title: Designed for a lifetime of work
ergonomics.body: Good loupes correct the way you sit. Viewing angle and weight distribution are set to take the load off the neck and shoulders.

custom.title: Made for one face
custom.body: Your pupillary distance, viewing height and working distance are measured, and the loupes are built to match.
